arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Garre argued that a trained dog's alert establishes probable cause to search a vehicle.
Mr. Gifford argued that no canine exception exists to the totality of the circumstances test.
Mr. Palmore argued that trained dogs reliably detect target odors in critical security roles.

paragraphs: Florida wants the Court to hold that a dog's alert alone proves probable cause.
Harris wants the Court to require courts to examine the dog's reliability.
